Popups translated per language can render twice only if both copies carry conditions; on the audited homes no site rendered two popups.
findings.breaks_when: Deleting a zero-condition translated header/footer/popup on a Polylang-connect or WPML site removes that language's template and the connector falls back to the default language or to the theme header. Repairing `type_mismatch` templates by re-saving can change which template WPML shows.
findings.how_to_apply: audit.php: for every template record `translation_group` = `function_exists('pll_get_post_translations') ? pll_get_post_translations($id) : (function_exists('icl_object_id') ? apply_filters('wpml_element_translations', ...) : null)`; a template is 'unused' only if no member of its group has conditions and none is referenced by a Template/Loop widget. Report `type_mismatch` templates (meta `_elementor_template_type` empty or ≠ `elementor_library_type` term) separately as 'repair or trash'. Public check per language: `curl -s https://site/<lang>/ | grep -o "elementor-post-[0-9]*-css" | sort -u` must list exactly one header and one footer id.
findings.how_to_verify: Load the home page in each language and confirm one header, one footer and ≤1 mobile-menu popup `data-elementor-id` per page; the per-language post-N.css set differs only in header/footer/page IDs (kit ID identical).

findings.claim: post-N.css files per page = page + kit + header + footer + each rendered popup + each container/section template inserted via the Template widget (+ Pro single/archive template); loop items are inlined as `<style id="loop-N">` in Pro 4.3.1; `custom-frontend.min.css` replaces frontend.min.css when custom breakpoints exist; conditional `widget-*.min.css` files are the merged 'Improved CSS Loading'; the alpha `e_optimized_css_files` does not reduce the count.
findings.detail: Counts on the 10 homes (unique `id='elementor-post-N-css'` or `post-N.css`): fagitiotiszois 4 (8 kit, 67 page, 349 header, 351 footer); limnoupolis 4 (13852 page, 46472 kit, 46478 header, 46480 footer); marakaki 4 (30944 kit, 30947 header, 31482 footer, 31652 page); pallada 4; staging.limnoupolis 4; platonos 5 (+383 section template); voreniahorizon 4 but renamed by FlyingPress to `/wp-content/cache/flying-press/<hash>.post-N.css`; onar 8 ids (3395 kit, 6076 header, 6090 page, 6269 footer, 6302 popup, 7168/7619/9383 container templates) concatenated by LiteSpeed into 4 bundles (34/22/13/12 KB, each reported 100% unused by Lighthouse); kand: W3TC minify merges everything into 2 bundles (83f37.css 23 KB holds header 485 and popup 506 rules) and strips the ids; cretaforums: `elementor_css_print_method=internal` → a single `<style id="elementor-frontend-inline-css">`, 0 files. Elementor 4.3.5 source: `core/files/css/post.php` → handle `elementor-post-{id}`, inline dependency `elementor-frontend`; `core/files/css/base.php` `use_external_file()` = `'internal' !== get_option('elementor_css_print_method')`; `core/files/css/` has no global-css.php (the kit's styles are post-{kit_id}.css); `includes/frontend.php` registers `widget-{name}` styles for `widgets_with_styles()`/`widgets_with_responsive_styles()` (seen live: widget-loop-carousel.min.css, widget-form.min.css, custom-pro-widget-mega-menu.min.css 2-3 KB, custom-pro-widget-woocommerce-menu-cart.min.css 2 KB); experiment `e_optimized_css_files` ('Optimized CSS Files', alpha, default inactive): 'Keeps external CSS files available and consistent for sites behind page caching or a CDN' — a caching-consistency fix, not fewer files. Loop templates: every site with Loop Grid/Carousel prints `<style id="loop-342">`, `<style id="loop-1372">`, `<style id="loop-31733">`, `<style id="loop-2434">`, `<style id="loop-487">` inline once per template (no post-N.css link found for any loop-item id). Lighthouse render-blocking: limnoupolis post-46478 (header, 3 KB) 240 ms, pallada post-4252 (page, 4 KB) 150 ms, staging post-37550 (8 KB) 413 ms; all post-N.css requests are priority VeryHigh. Elementor 4.3.5 changelog (2026-10-13): 'Fix: Page editing can fail when Internal CSS Embedding is enabled'; 4.3.4: 'Fix: Widget styles can be missing when rendered inside saved Templates'.
findings.breaks_when: Switching `elementor_css_print_method` to internal on a site with page caching inlines 10-40 KB of CSS into every cached HTML page (bigger HTML, no CSS caching) and the 4.3.5 editor fix shows it is a less-tested path; combining files with LiteSpeed/W3TC breaks the per-file audit (count `data-elementor-type` wrappers instead).
findings.how_to_apply: Audit rule: `elementor_docs_per_page` = number of distinct `data-elementor-type="..." data-elementor-id="N"` wrappers (page, header, footer, popup, container/section, loop-item) and `post_css_files` = distinct `elementor-post-N-css` ids (0 when combined/inlined — report the cache plugin instead). Target ≤4 on brochure pages (page + kit + header + footer). Fixes: remove popups from pages that do not open them; replace Template-widget inserts of whole containers with the content itself (saves one file each); keep `elementor_css_print_method=external` and let the cache plugin's used-CSS feature inline the critical part; run Elementor > Tools > Regenerate Files & Data after 4.3.4+ upgrade.
findings.how_to_verify: `curl -s <url> | grep -o 'data-elementor-type="[a-z-]*" data-elementor-id="[0-9]*"' | sort | uniq -c` and `grep -o "elementor-post-[0-9]*-css" | sort -u`; Lighthouse 'Eliminate render-blocking resources' should list no post-N.css after used-CSS inlining.

findings.claim: Cache-plugin used/critical CSS covers the visible header and not the hidden popups: FlyingPress, LiteSpeed CCSS/UCSS and Perfmatters extract CSS for the rendered viewport, and FlyingPress explicitly says popups/modals and elements hidden on initial load may not be detected unless safelisted.
findings.detail: FlyingPress 'Remove Unused CSS' (doc dated May 23, 2025): 'loads only the CSS required for the initial viewport (above-the-fold content). The rest is deferred and loaded when the browser is idle'; used CSS is inlined in `<style id="flying-press-css">`; 'for elements that are: Dynamically injected (e.g. popups, modals, sliders), Hidden on initial load (e.g. tabs, dropdowns), Shown only after interaction (e.g. menus on hover) …it's possible we may not detect them. You can safelist such styles by entering the related CSS selectors' (selectors only, e.g. `.popup-overlay`, partial matches allowed). LiteSpeed Page Optimization docs: 'Critical CSS is the collection of styles required to display above-the-fold content properly. These styles are inserted inline'; UCSS 'may be unique for each page' or per post type via API filter; 'UCSS Inline' stores it inline; 'CCSS Per URL' OFF generates per post type and 'may result in incorrect CSS styling if your site uses a page builder'. Perfmatters 'Remove Unused CSS': Used CSS Method Inline (default, 'best for PageSpeed scores but also increases the HTML page size') or File; 'a site using a heavy page builder like Elementor will most likely need more exclusions'. Consequence: with used-CSS on, popup styles are deferred (correct) and the popup's own post-N.css still ships as a deferred/async file; header CSS is inlined because it is visible; a sticky header's scrolled state (`.elementor-sticky--effects`) and mega-menu dropdowns are 'shown only after interaction' and typically need safelisting.
findings.breaks_when: Mega-menu dropdowns, sticky-scrolled header styles, Menu Cart drawer, popups and off-canvas panels open unstyled (FOUC) until the deferred CSS arrives, or stay broken if the deferred stylesheet is never loaded; LiteSpeed CCSS per post type applied to Elementor pages with different layouts mis-styles above-the-fold content.
findings.how_to_apply: FlyingPress: Settings > CSS > Remove Unused CSS ON, add selectors `.elementor-location-popup .elementor-popup-modal .dialog-widget-content .elementor-sticky--effects .e-n-menu-content .elementor-menu-cart__container .elementor-off-canvas` to 'Include specific CSS selectors'. LiteSpeed: Page Optimization > CSS Settings: CSS Combine + Generate UCSS + UCSS Inline, Load CSS Asynchronously ON (CCSS generated), keep 'CCSS Per URL' ON for Elementor sites; add the same selectors to UCSS Whitelist. Perfmatters: CSS > Remove Unused CSS, Used CSS Method Inline, add the selectors to 'CSS Selectors'.
findings.how_to_verify: After enabling: open the mobile menu/popup/mega menu/cart on 3 pages and screenshot; scroll to trigger sticky; Lighthouse 'Reduce unused CSS' and 'Eliminate render-blocking resources' drop; inspect `<style id="flying-press-css">` (FlyingPress) or the inline CCSS block (LiteSpeed) for `.elementor-<headerid>` rules present and `.elementor-<popupid>` absent.

findings.claim: Header per-page tax measured in Lighthouse: Pro elements-handlers.min.js 65-75 KB on every page, smartmenus 6-7 KB (Nav Menu/WP Menu), jquery.sticky 1 KB + e-sticky CSS, mega-menu and menu-cart CSS 2-3 KB each flagged render-blocking, Menu Cart's `?wc-ajax=get_refreshed_fragments` XHR 1.5-5 s, and header entrance animations (`elementor-invisible`) that hide the header until JS runs; the header logo takes `fetchpriority="high"` on 9 of 10 sites.
findings.detail:
Lighthouse mobile runs (2026-10-15): `elementor-pro/assets/js/elements-handlers.min.js?ver=4.3.1` 65-75 KB transfer (limnoupolis 159 ms main thread); `elementor-pro/assets/lib/smartmenus/jquery.smartmenus.min.js?ver=1.2.1` 6-7 KB on cretaforums, pallada, platonos, voreniahorizon, marakaki (nav-menu widget; Pro 4.3.1 still ships smartmenus and `jquery.sticky.min.js?ver=4.3.1` 1 KB + `sticky.min.css`; marakaki header `_elementor_page_assets` lists scripts `smartmenus`, `e-sticky`); `uploads/elementor/css/custom-pro-widget-mega-menu.min.css` 2-3 KB and `custom-pro-widget-woocommerce-menu-cart.min.css` 2 KB render-blocking (limnoupolis 240 ms); WooCommerce `cart-fragments.min.js` 1 KB triggers `?wc-ajax=get_refreshed_fragments` taking 1,706 ms (kand), 1,508 ms (limnoupolis), 5,001 ms (staging), uncacheable and hitting PHP on every page view. Header entrance animations: `elementor-invisible` elements inside the header wrapper on marakaki (6), voreniahorizon (6), cretaforums (3), pallada (1) — the header (and often the LCP heading) stays invisible until elementor frontend JS + waypoints run; Lighthouse LCP elements on these sites were `

`/`

` text or the cookie banner, not the hero. `fetchpriority="high"` landed on the header logo on 9/10 homes (Elementor Optimized Image Loading marks the first image), e.g. limnoupolis `uploads/2023/01/1.png` while its real LCP `` is lazy. Detection in public HTML: `elementor-widget-nav-menu` / `elementor-widget-n-menu` (`e-n-menu`) / `elementor-widget-wp-menu`, `jquery.smartmenus`, `jquery.sticky`, `data-settings="...sticky..."`, `elementor-widget-woocommerce-menu-cart` + `cart-fragments`, `elementor-widget-search-form`, `elementor-widget-social-icons` with `e-font-icon-svg` (SVG, no icon font) vs `fab fa-` classes + `fontawesome` CSS, `elementor-invisible` inside the header wrapper, `fetchpriority="high"` on the logo.
findings.breaks_when: Disabling cart fragments breaks the live mini-cart count/drawer in the header (cart updates only on page load) — acceptable on brochure pages, not on shop/product/cart pages; removing jquery.sticky needs CSS `position: sticky` on the header container or the header scrolls away; replacing Nav Menu with the Menu widget changes markup (custom CSS may break).
findings.how_to_apply: Header: Elementor > header template: remove Entrance Animation on every header element (Advanced > Motion Effects > Entrance Animation: None); logo image: set exact width/height and let the hero image carry priority (Image widget on the hero: Lazy Load No; if the logo still gets fetchpriority use filter `wp_get_loading_optimization_attributes` to skip the logo or Perfmatters 'Exclude from Lazy Loading' + 'Fetch Priority' on the hero). Menu: prefer the WP Menu widget (no smartmenus/mega CSS) or the Menu widget without Mega content; one menu per header. Menu Cart: remove from brochure-site headers; on shops use Perfmatters > WooCommerce > 'Disable Cart Fragments' (keeps fragments on cart/checkout) or WooCommerce's own 'Enable AJAX add to cart' off. Sticky: Advanced > Motion Effects > Sticky: None and use CSS `position:sticky; top:0` on the header container, or keep Pro sticky (1 KB) — small gain. Social icons: keep `e_font_icon_svg` ON so icons are inline SVG. Search: use the Search widget without live results.
findings.how_to_verify: curl the home: 0 `elementor-invisible` inside `data-elementor-type="header"`, no `jquery.smartmenus`/`jquery.sticky` requests unless intended, no `wc-ajax=get_refreshed_fragments` in Network on brochure pages, `fetchpriority="high"` on the hero image not the logo; Lighthouse LCP element is the hero and 'Largest Contentful Paint image was lazily loaded' passes; TBT unchanged or lower.

findings.claim: Footers on the audited sites are 35-100 KB of raw HTML per page and four of them embed a Pro Form (widget-form CSS + form JS bundle, reCAPTCHA when enabled) on every page; no Facebook Page SDK or Google Maps iframe was found in any of the 10 footers, so the footer tax here is forms, payment/social icon rows and sheer markup.
findings.detail: Raw footer wrapper bytes (from `data-elementor-type="footer"` to end of document, mobile UA): onar 99.8 KB, kand 93.7 KB, marakaki 81.5 KB, limnoupolis 74.5 KB, pallada 64.7 KB, platonos 56.9 KB, staging 45.0 KB, voreniahorizon 38.1 KB, cretaforums 35.3 KB, fagitiotiszois 33.5 KB. Pro Forms in footers: kand (486), marakaki (31482, `_elementor_page_assets` styles include widget-form), voreniahorizon (2643), platonos (381 → `elementor-pro/assets/css/widget-form.min.css` 1 KB on every page); onar loads `elementor-pro/assets/js/form.<hash>.bundle.min.js` 5 KB. `recaptcha` strings appear on marakaki (6), pallada (4), voreniahorizon (4), cretaforums (4) — from Complianz/FAZ cookie managers blocking rules rather than footer forms on the home pages (no `recaptcha/api.js` request in Lighthouse). Payment icon markup: kand footer 7 'payment' mentions (WooCommerce), staging 1. Footer iframes: none. Google Maps widgets exist only in page content (audit: onar 18, pallada 8 `google_maps` widgets). Detection: `elementor-widget-form` inside the footer wrapper, `recaptcha_site_key`/`field_type: recaptcha` in `_elementor_data`, `<iframe` inside the footer, `connect.facebook.net`/`fb-page`, `elementor-widget-google_maps`.
findings.breaks_when: Moving the footer form to a Contact page loses the 'form on every page' lead capture the client may want — a business decision, not a technical break; reCAPTCHA v2 is required by some clients' spam policy.
findings.how_to_apply: Replace the footer Form widget with a button linking to /contact/ (the Pro Form, its CSS/JS and reCAPTCHA then load on one page); keep newsletter signups in a popup opened by selector only on the pages that have the button, or as a plain Mailchimp/Brevo HTML form without reCAPTCHA; render payment icons as one inline SVG sprite or a single WebP; keep the footer to ≤3 containers deep (audit `footer_bytes` target ≤30 KB raw). Add to the build checklist: 'footer has no form, no iframe, no map, no video, no animation'.
findings.how_to_verify: After the change: `curl -s <url> | grep -c elementor-widget-form` = 0 on non-contact pages; Network shows no `widget-form.min.css`, `form.*.bundle.min.js` or `recaptcha/api.js`; footer wrapper bytes measured with the same regex drop below 30 KB; submit the contact page form once end-to-end.

findings.claim: Loop Grid/Carousel cost = N rendered copies of the loop template's widgets plus one inline `<style id="loop-N">` per template, Swiper (36-41 KB JS + 4-5 KB CSS, 186-384 ms scripting) only when a Loop/Media/Image Carousel is present (conditional since Pro 3.27.0), and image sizing is governed by the loop template's Image/Featured Image widget resolution; the lean rule is one loop template per listing, a fixed image size, grid not carousel on mobile, no animations on the Loop widget or inside items.
findings.detail: Live homes: kand 25 loop items from 3 templates (487/489/491) across 5 Loop Grids + 5 Loop Carousels, Swiper 36 KB; marakaki 22 items (31733) in carousels, 389 'swiper' mentions; pallada 11 items from 3 templates, Swiper 37 KB (142 ms); fagitiotiszois 8 carousel items, Swiper 402 ms total / 186 ms scripting; voreniahorizon Loop Grid 2434 with widget setting `"_animation":"fadeIn","_animation_delay":400` (grid invisible until JS) and each item rendering the site logo SVG at `width="1689"` `attachment-full`, Swiper 589 ms total / 384 ms scripting. Image sizes seen: `attachment-large size-large` 800 px with srcset (fagitiotiszois, pallada, kand), `attachment-medium` 357-500 px (marakaki, with Variation Swatches placeholder SVGs); the first 2-3 loop images on kand lack `loading="lazy"` (Optimized Image Loading eager-loads the first images). Help 'Loop Grid widget' (Last Update June 19, 2026): Pagination options 'Numbers', 'Previous/Next', 'Numbers + Previous/Next', 'Load on Click', 'Infinite Scroll'; 'Paginate your loop' (Feb 9, 2025): reload modes 'Page Reload' vs 'AJAX – Reloads only the loop grid widget', Load More button, Infinite Scroll ('users scrolling will often be interrupted as new items need time to load'); 'Add an alternate template in a loop grid' (Sep 2, 2025) adds a second template (second inline style + widgets). Loop Carousel help (Sep 15, 2026): Autoplay, infinite scroll, slides to display per device. Pro changelog: 3.27.0 (2025-01-20) 'Enabled conditional loading of Swiper.js based on widget dependencies'; 4.2.0 (2026-07-20) 'Fix: Load on Click duplicates the initial posts…when using multiple Posts widgets'; 3.10.1 'Fix: Lazyload not working after load more action in loop builder items'. JetSmartFilters (kand, marakaki, pallada) adds its own JS and re-renders the grid via Ajax. On marakaki, 20 published loop-item templates, 11 unreferenced by any Loop Grid/Carousel/Posts widget, and home-template documents 38085/40768 reference non-existent `template_id`s (717953, 725023…) — dangling references after a kit import.
findings.breaks_when: Switching a carousel to a grid on mobile changes the design (client sign-off); reducing loop image resolution below the rendered width makes thumbnails blurry on 3x screens; removing `_animation` on the Loop Grid is safe. Deleting an unreferenced loop template that a JetSmartFilters/JetEngine listing or a Dynamic.ooo PDF template references by ID breaks that listing — check those plugins' settings first.
findings.how_to_apply: Build rule: one loop-item template per content type (product, post, room); in the template's Image/Featured Image widget set Image Resolution to a registered size matching the card width (e.g. `medium_large` 768 px or a custom 600x600) never 'Full'; no Entrance Animation on the Loop widget (`_animation` None) or inside items; Loop Grid with 'Numbers' or 'Load on Click' pagination and AJAX reload, not Infinite Scroll; use Loop Carousel only on desktop (Responsive > hide on mobile) and show a 1-2 column grid on mobile; Items Per Page ≤ 8 above the fold. Audit: parse `_elementor_data` for `widgetType` in (loop-grid, loop-carousel, posts) and read `settings.template_id`, `_animation`, `pagination_type`, `pagination_load_type`; count `data-elementor-type="loop-item"` wrappers per page and `<style id="loop-N">` tags; flag `attachment-full` or width > 1000 inside loop items.
findings.how_to_verify: Lighthouse mobile: no `swiper.min.js` request on pages without a carousel; 'Properly size images' lists no loop images; `grep -c 'data-elementor-type="loop-item"'` ≤ 12 per page; items visible without JS (disable JS in DevTools → grid still rendered).
tools: Elementor Pro Loop Grid / Loop Carousel

findings.claim: 'Entire Site' headers, footers and popups also ship on checkout, booking steps and landing pages that do not need them; Elementor's page layouts `elementor_canvas` ('Elementor Canvas', no header/footer) and `elementor_header_footer` ('Elementor Full Width') plus Exclude conditions are the built-in way to drop the stack per page.
findings.detail: Elementor 4.3.5 `modules/page-templates/module.php`: `TEMPLATE_CANVAS = 'elementor_canvas'` labelled 'Elementor Canvas', `TEMPLATE_HEADER_FOOTER = 'elementor_header_footer'` labelled 'Elementor Full Width', `TEMPLATE_THEME = 'elementor_theme'`; templates in `modules/page-templates/templates/canvas.php` and `header-footer.php`. Help 'Use the Elementor Canvas page layout' (Last Update June 1, 2026) exists for this. On the audited sites every header/footer condition is `include/general` (marakaki 30947/31482, limnoupolis, kand 485/486, pallada 780/1025, onar 6076/6269) with no excludes, so WooCommerce checkout and YITH/WooCommerce Bookings steps carry the mega menu, menu cart, popups and footer forms. Pro conditions support `Exclude` rows (help 'Set conditions…', Oct 1, 2026: 'use the left dropdown to determine if you're going to Include or Exclude pages'); the popup conditions help (Configure a popup) uses the same dialog. A lighter 'checkout header' template with `Include > Singular > Pages > Checkout` plus `Exclude` of Checkout on the main header is the standard pattern; whether a more specific include beats a general one automatically (priority) was not confirmed in the pages opened — use explicit Exclude rows.
findings.breaks_when: Canvas removes the header/footer entirely (no navigation, no cookie banner placement if the banner is in the footer template); Full Width keeps the theme's header/footer, not Elementor's; a landing page on Canvas that needs the GTM container must still have GTM in the theme `<head>` (Canvas prints `wp_head()`/`wp_footer()`, so theme/plugin scripts still load).
findings.how_to_apply: Landing/booking pages: Page Settings > Page Layout > 'Elementor Canvas' (post meta `_wp_page_template = elementor_canvas`). Checkout: build a minimal header (logo + phone) with `Include > Singular > Pages > Checkout` and add `Exclude > Singular > Pages > Checkout` to the main header, footer and every popup. Audit: list pages with `_wp_page_template` in (elementor_canvas, elementor_header_footer) and report which header/footer/popup IDs render on the checkout, cart, booking and top 3 landing URLs (curl + `data-elementor-type` count).
findings.how_to_verify: curl checkout/booking/landing URLs: `data-elementor-type="header"`/`footer`/`popup` wrappers match the intent (0 on Canvas; the light header id on checkout); complete a test booking/order on staging; Lighthouse on the landing page shows fewer stylesheets and no popup CSS.

findings.claim: The mobile-menu-as-popup pattern (Elementor's own 'Create a responsive popup menu' tutorial) adds a second document, a second nav-menu widget, a second logo and a popup CSS file to every page; the Pro Off-Canvas widget or the Menu widget's built-in dropdown keeps the mobile menu inside the header document.
findings.detail: onar popup 6302 'Mobile-Menu' (12.2 KB raw, widgets: icon, theme-site-logo, image, polylang-language-switcher, button, icon-list, nav-menu, html, social-icons; `include` condition; post-6302.css 3 KB) and marakaki popup 37731 'mobile menu categories' (nav-menu, scoped to product archives, `_elementor_page_assets` styles widget-nav-menu, e-animation-fadeInLeft, e-popup; scripts smartmenus) follow the help article 'Create a responsive popup menu' (Last Update June 24, 2024). Help 'Off-Canvas widget' (Last Update September 15, 2026): 'The Off Canvas widget allows you to create containers that do not appear when the page initially loads. These containers only appear after a visitor has taken a defined action such as clicking a button'; it lives inside the header template (marakaki header 30947 already lists `widget-off-canvas` in its page assets), so it needs no display conditions, no conditions-cache entry, no `e-popup`/dialog CSS and no extra post-N.css; Element Caching help lists 'Off Canvas' among elements that are always cached. The Off-Canvas content is still in the page HTML (hidden) — the saving is the second document, duplicate logo/images, the dialog module and one CSS file, not the menu markup itself. Not measured: byte-for-byte comparison of popup vs off-canvas on the same site (no staging change allowed).
findings.breaks_when: A popup menu that is reused via `Open By Selector` from several templates (header + sticky header + footer) has no 1:1 Off-Canvas equivalent per opener; Off-Canvas requires the Pro Menu/container features (Flexbox containers) and changes the mobile-menu markup for custom CSS.
findings.how_to_apply: New builds: use the Menu widget (hamburger dropdown) or an Off-Canvas widget inside the header for the mobile menu; never a popup. Existing sites: rebuild the mobile menu as Off-Canvas in the header, then trash the popup (and its translation). Audit flag: popup whose widgets include `nav-menu`/`mega-menu`/`theme-site-logo` and whose conditions are `include/general` → 'mobile-menu popup, convert to Off-Canvas'.
findings.how_to_verify: After conversion: home HTML has 0 `data-elementor-type="popup"`, no `elementor-post-<popupid>-css`, no `dialog.min.js`/`dialog.min.css` requests (Pro loads the dialog lib for popups); open the hamburger on 3 viewports and check focus trap/ESC close (a11y) and the language switcher.

findings.claim: Third-party Ajax-loaded popups exist only in JetPopup ('Loading content with Ajax' + 'Force Loading'); Premium Addons' Modal Box renders its Elementor template inline, and Dynamic.ooo adds visibility rules to Elementor popups rather than lazy loading — so the Ajax route is a last resort with known form-handling caveats.
findings.detail: Crocoblock JetPopup 'Popup Presets Overview': settings include 'Loading Content with AJAX toggle, if enabled, loads the popup after appearing to increase the site's loading speed. This toggle turns on the Force Loading toggle to load the popup every time you open the popup' and a 'Display Conditions' button. Caveats from search results (GitHub issues #1968 fatal error with an Elementor Form inside an Ajax-loaded popup; #8152 JetFormBuilder conditional fields on second open) could not be opened (GitHub returned 403) — treat as unverified. Premium Addons 'Modal Box Widget Tutorial': 'Content to Show: You can choose between Text Editor and Elementor Template'; triggers Button/Image/Text/Lottie/Page Load, 'Page Load Delay', 'On Page Exit Intent'; no Ajax option documented → the template is rendered into the page. Dynamic.ooo help search for 'popup' returns 'Dynamic Visibility for Elementor Popups' (show/hide rules) and 'Modals - Settings' for its own Modals widget (On Page Load, Hide on scroll, ESC) — no Ajax fetch documented. Elementor Pro itself: no lazy fetch (finding 1). Any Ajax popup still requires its trigger JS on every page and an uncached admin-ajax/REST hit per open, and Elementor Pro Form submissions depend on the form's nonce/handlers being initialised after injection.
findings.breaks_when: Elementor Pro Form, reCAPTCHA, Loop Grid or JetSmartFilters inside an Ajax-loaded popup: handlers are not re-initialised or the nonce is stale (the Crocoblock issues); page caches cannot cache the Ajax response; GTM click triggers fire before content exists.
findings.how_to_apply: Only after conditions are tightened and media removed: for JetPopup set 'Loading content with Ajax' ON per popup and keep forms out of Ajax popups; for Elementor-only sites prefer deleting the popup or moving its content to a page. Do not add JetPopup to a site just for this (new plugin, new CSS/JS on every page).
findings.how_to_verify: Network tab: popup content request appears only on open; submit any form inside it twice (second open after close) and after a page-cache hit; run the page through Lighthouse with the popup closed (no popup assets) and open (no console errors).

findings.claim: audit.php should add a read-only `theme_builder` section built from `_elementor_template_type`, the `elementor_library_type` taxonomy, `_elementor_conditions`, `_elementor_popup_display_settings`, `_elementor_page_assets`, `_elementor_css` and a walk of `_elementor_data` for `template_id` references; a prototype of these queries ran on marakaki in 210 ms over 298 documents.
findings.detail: Meta/taxonomy names confirmed live on marakaki (Pro 4.3.1): meta keys on a popup = `_elementor_conditions`, `_elementor_controls_usage`, `_elementor_css` (array with `status` file|inline|empty), `_elementor_data`, `_elementor_edit_mode`, `_elementor_element_cache`, `_elementor_page_assets` ({styles:[widget-nav-menu, e-popup, e-animation-fadeInLeft], scripts:[smartmenus, elementor-frontend]}), `_elementor_page_settings`, `_elementor_popup_display_settings`, `_elementor_pro_version`, `_elementor_source`, `_elementor_template_type`, `_elementor_version`; taxonomy `elementor_library_type` term slugs: header, footer, popup, loop-item, page, container, section, widget, single-post, single-page, archive, product, product-archive, search-results, error-404. Fields to add: (1) `templates_by_type`: `SELECT t.slug type, COUNT(*) n, SUM(c.meta_value IS NOT NULL AND c.meta_value<>'a:0:{}') with_conditions FROM wp_posts p JOIN wp_term_relationships tr ON tr.object_id=p.ID JOIN wp_term_taxonomy tt ON tt.term_taxonomy_id=tr.term_taxonomy_id AND tt.taxonomy='elementor_library_type' JOIN wp_terms t ON t.term_id=tt.term_id LEFT JOIN wp_postmeta c ON c.post_id=p.ID AND c.meta_key='_elementor_conditions' WHERE p.post_type='elementor_library' AND p.post_status IN ('publish','draft','private') GROUP BY t.slug` (marakaki: header 4/2, footer 2/1, popup 7/2, loop-item 22/0, product-archive 15/8, single-post 12/5, page 18, container 7). (2) `templates[]` per header/footer/popup/single/archive/loop-item: id, title, type, term, status, conditions (array of 'include|exclude/name/sub_name/sub_id'), popup_display {triggers, timing}, page_assets, css_status, widgets, elements, flags {animations (`_animation`/`animation` ≠ none), motion_fx, sticky, forms, recaptcha (form_fields field_type recaptcha|recaptcha_v3 or recaptcha_site_key), videos (video, video-playlist), maps (google_maps), facebook (facebook-page|embed|comments), menus by widgetType (nav-menu, mega-menu, e-wp-menu, wp-widget-nav_menu), menu_cart (woocommerce-menu-cart), search (search-form|search), social (social-icons), bg_images, bg_video}, translation_group (pll_get_post_translations / wpml_element_translations). (3) `popups`: popups_without_conditions, popups_entire_site (`include/general`), popups_manual_only (triggers == []), popups_with_media_or_forms, popups_mobile_menu (nav-menu + general). (4) `conditions_cache`: `get_option('elementor_pro_theme_builder_conditions')` keys and counts vs meta → `stale`. (5) `loop_templates`: published loop-item IDs, `referenced_by` (walk `_elementor_data` of all docs for widgetType loop-grid|loop-carousel|posts → settings.template_id; template widget → settings.template_id), `unreferenced` (marakaki: 11 of 20), `dangling_template_ids` (IDs with no post: marakaki 717953, 717994, 718062, 718161, 725023, 725057, 725234, 725269, 725794, 725803, 717956). (6) `templates_unused_safe_to_trash`: no conditions AND no translation group member with conditions AND not referenced. (7) `type_mismatch`: `_elementor_template_type` empty or ≠ term (marakaki 10, pallada 2). (8) `public_html` per key URL: counts of `data-elementor-type` wrappers by type, `elementor-post-N-css` ids, `<style id="loop-N">`, header `elementor-invisible`, `fetchpriority="high"` src, popup bytes/gzip, `wc-ajax=get_refreshed_fragments`.
findings.breaks_when: Read-only; the only hazard is memory/time on sites with thousands of documents — keep the `_elementor_data` walk one document at a time (as the existing audit.php does) and cap at 3,000 documents.
findings.how_to_apply: Append to /home/user/everything-claude/plugins/elementor-lean/skills/elementor-audit/scripts/audit.php a `$out['theme_builder']` block using the queries above; reuse the existing `$walk` closure by adding `template_id` capture and the widget flags; add a curl-based `profile-url.sh` section for the public-HTML counters. Keep it paste-able into Novamira `novamira/execute-php` (no writes).
findings.how_to_verify: Run on marakaki and compare with Novamira `elementor-list-templates` (60 rows, 4 popups) and `elementor-get-template-conditions` for 37731 (include/woocommerce/product_archive), 33768 (include/woocommerce/product), 30947 (include/general); the loop walk must return 20 published loop templates with 11 unreferenced and the dangling IDs above; runtime < 1 s.
